```python
@torch.no_grad()
def update_bn_stats(model: nn.Module, data_loader: Iterable[Any], num_iters:
    int=200, progress: Optional[str]=None) ->None:
    """
    Update the running_mean and running_var of all BN modules in the model.
    
    Args:
        model: a model containing BN modules
        data_loader: an iterable of batches
        num_iters: number of iterations to process
        progress: optional progress bar description
    """
    bn_layers = get_bn_modules(model)
    
    if not bn_layers:
        return
    
    # Initialize estimators for each BN layer
    estimators = [
        _PopulationVarianceEstimator(bn.running_mean, bn.running_var)
        for bn in bn_layers
    ]
    
    # Create iterator from data_loader
    data_iter = iter(data_loader)
    
    # Iterate through batches
    iterator = range(num_iters)
    if progress:
        iterator = tqdm.tqdm(iterator, desc=progress)
    
    for _ in iterator:
        try:
            batch = next(data_iter)
        except StopIteration:
            raise AssertionError(
                f"Not enough data in data_loader. Expected {num_iters} iterations "
                f"but data_loader exhausted earlier."
            )
        
        # Forward pass to compute batch statistics
        model(batch)
        
        # Update estimators with batch statistics from each BN layer
        for bn_layer, estimator in zip(bn_layers, estimators):
            batch_size = batch.shape[0]
            estimator.update(bn_layer.running_mean, bn_layer.running_var, batch_size)
    
    # Update BN layers with computed population statistics
    for bn_layer, estimator in zip(bn_layers, estimators):
        bn_layer.running_mean.copy_(estimator.pop_mean)
        bn_layer.running_var.copy_(estimator.pop_var)
